metadata.case_name: LI KWOK KEE v. CHINA HK WAH LEE LIMITED

injuries.description: fractures at the distal radius and ulnar styloid (left wrist)
source: As a result, the plaintiff suffered left wrist fracture injuries.
X‑ray of the wrist showed fractures at the distal radius and ulnar styloid.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: residual pain and stiffness in his left wrist
some mild stiffness of the index finger at the metarcarpophalangeal joint
handgrip on the left side was slightly weaker on manual testing
There were two surgical scars of 2 cm and 1 cm in length respectively on the left wrist

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation (surgery on 19 May 2011)
physiotherapy (sixty sessions between 30 May 2011 and 23 March 2012 and nine further sessions between July 2012 and October 2012)

losses.description: Residual pain and stiffness in the left wrist, reduction of dorsiflexion, mild stiffness of the index finger, slightly weaker left handgrip and two surgical scars on the left wrist.
